A career at SanFreight

SanFreight brings together deep expertise across every mode of global freight.

The diversity of skills across our team lets us build and run reliable logistics — managing every stage of the chain, from route planning to final delivery. Growing your career at SanFreight means being part of what keeps trade moving — and making a real impact on clients across the world by using your full potential.

Our commitment
Career opportunities and development.
SanFreight has been built around a strong entrepreneurial spirit that puts people at its core, encouraging them to think ahead, take ownership, and seize opportunities.
By joining SanFreight, you'll find more than a fast-moving environment that rewards initiative — you'll find a company committed to the continuous growth of its people, giving every team member the room to develop, do their best work, and grow with us.
Benefits and working conditions
Well-being at work
We believe great work is only possible when people feel supported — a safe, respectful workplace, fair rewards for the effort our teams put in, and the tools to do the job well.

By putting our people at the heart of how we operate, we build a culture where careers grow, effort is recognised, and everyone shares in what we achieve together. This is our promise at SanFreight.
Ethics and dedication
Equality and diversity
SanFreight is firmly committed to equal opportunity and diversity. Every member of our team, with their own perspective and background, brings real value to how we work and grow together.

We foster an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and every talent is valued. For us, equality and diversity aren't just principles — they're a core part of our strength and our success.
Together, let's build the future of your career
At SanFreight, we care about the world we move through. Our mission is to keep global trade flowing responsibly — anticipating the challenges of tomorrow and moving every shipment with care, precision, and a lower impact on the planet.
